news.get_story

Retrieves the news story items.

Available as lseg.data.news.get_story.

get_story(story_id: str, format: Format | str = Format.HTML) -> str

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
story_id str Yes News Story ID.
format Format | str No Format.HTML Response format.

Returns

str

Story html or text response

Example

import lseg.data as ld
response = ld.news.get_story("urn:newsml:reuters.com:20220713:nL1N2YU10J", format=ld.news.Format.TEXT)

Related types

Format

Format of a news story: plain text or HTML.

Name Value Description
Format.HTML 'Html'
Format.TEXT 'Text'
